5 تطوّح : see 1, in four places. ―
-b2- Also [He lost his way, or was made to lose his way, and] he cast himself hither and thither (S, K) فِى البِلَادِ in the countries. (S.) ―
-b3- And He, or it, went and came, or moved to and fro, in the air: and he moved to and fro in sleep, upon the back of a camel. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
